commentary: Market breadth remains fragile at 39 despite benchmark index resilience, signaling a split market under Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil market-direction rules. Institutional selective accumulation exists, but broad participation is lacking. Under Mark Minervini's SEPA framework, progressive exposure is mandatory: capital must strictly follow confirmed Stage 2 leadership rather than anticipatory trades. CANSLIM discipline requires verifiable quarterly earnings and sales acceleration to validate true market leaders; setups showing decelerating bottom-line growth must be relegated to watchlists. Until market breadth sustainably reclaims constructive levels above 50, exposure must remain measured, stop losses kept tight to base invalidation pivots, and risk cut immediately when price violates structured stop levels.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AARTIPHARM.technical: Price tracks above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, completing a double-bottom consolidation. Volume at 1.24x confirms institutional support, while RSI at 68 reflects constructive momentum without overextension. Relative strength is firming, but a decisive volume breakout through the 1020.52 trigger is needed to validate continuation.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Aarti Pharmalabs demonstrates modest top-line growth of 13.9% and healthy 25% operating margins with low leverage (debt-to-equity 0.28). However, net profit declined 6.1% YoY in the latest quarter, failing CANSLIM C-criterion standards and reflecting persistent margin pressure in API intermediates.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis fails on a drop below the 929.48 swing low, demanding strict Minervini stop discipline to protect capital.

AARTISURF.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing 20-session resistance on massive 10.24x volume expansion, confirming heavy institutional accumulation. Moving averages are stacked positively with price above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. MACD expansion and strong relative-strength line support a high-velocity Stage 2 advance.
AARTISURF.fundamental: Aarti Surfactants displays stellar CANSLIM characteristics with Q2 revenue climbing 62.5% YoY to Rs 291 Cr and net profit surging over 700% YoY to Rs 12.59 Cr. Working capital improvement from 32 to 21 days and expanding operating margins provide robust fundamental backing.
AARTISURF.risk: Setup invalidates on a high-volume breakdown below 561.76; cut losses swiftly per SEPA risk-management guidelines.

ABDL.technical: Clear SEPA breakout clearing a 20-session high to reach a new 52-week high on 1.93x average volume. The stock demonstrates persistent relative strength above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Bullish momentum indicators corroborate sustained institutional sponsorship.
ABDL.fundamental: Allied Blenders shows steady revenue expansion of 15.9% to Rs 1,148 Cr and operating margins of 13.3%. While net profit grew 17.9% YoY, EPS acceleration remains below O'Neil's optimal 25% threshold, though post-IPO balance sheet deleveraging provides constructive financial tailwinds.
ABDL.risk: Breakout fails if price closes below 712.03, requiring an immediate stop to limit portfolio drawdown.

AEROENTER.technical: Tight consolidation within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot, positioned constructively above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Volatility contraction is visible with RSI at 59 and positive MACD alignment, but needs heavy breakout volume above 159.76 to confirm demand.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Aeroflex Enterprises reports strong revenue growth of 45% to Rs 250 Cr and virtually zero debt, but EPS growth decelerated from Q1's subsidiary-divestment-inflated +616.7% to +83.7% in Q2. One-off other income skews fundamental quality under CANSLIM examination.
AEROENTER.risk: Breach below 146.48 swing support negates the consolidation setup, triggering a disciplined exit.

AGARWALEYE.technical: Constructing a classical double-bottom pattern with long lower wicks confirming persistent accumulation at support. Price is pressing the 572.47 neckline above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. MACD is positive above signal and zero, reflecting solid underlying momentum.
AGARWALEYE.fundamental: Dr. Agarwal's delivers prime CANSLIM credentials with revenue expanding 31% YoY to Rs 655 Cr and net profit jumping 57% YoY. Operating margins near 27% and a pristine balance sheet (debt-to-equity 0.07) reinforce institutional sponsorship and network expansion visibility.
AGARWALEYE.risk: Failure to hold the 531.32 base low invalidates the pattern, demanding an immediate stop-loss exit.

ALICON.technical: Carving out a double-bottom base above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Price is testing the 995.99 entry pivot on 1.45x volume expansion. Momentum is intact with RSI at 68 and MACD above zero, confirming an orderly Stage 2 uptrend.
ALICON.fundamental: Alicon Castalloy delivered record Q2 revenue of Rs 652 Cr (+50.4% YoY) driven by EV machining orders, with PAT rising 26.7% YoY. Raw material cost inflation compressed operating margins, and elevated working capital requires monitoring under CANSLIM parameters.
ALICON.risk: Thesis is negated on a decline below 908.77; cut losses promptly to protect capital.
